cover_letter.greeting: Dear Ziff Davis Lifestyle Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior FP&A Analyst role supporting the Lifestyle Group. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because Dwell, Domino and Business of Home earn money from ads, subscriptions, events, print and affiliate commerce all at once, and partnering with a GM on that mix is the kind of finance work I want to do.

At Thomson Reuters I worked with the finance team on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and month-end close for the ANZ region, and managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of inflows. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation.

That lines up with the budget, rolling forecasts, close and monthly variance packages you describe, and my work on marketing-channel budgets at JPMorgan Asset Management should help with the sales and marketing questions the GM brings. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Senior FP&A Analyst role for the Lifestyle Group at Ziff Davis.
